title: Talent Management
overview: As organizations increasingly recognize the significance of integrated talent management systems, it becomes vital to design a comprehensive and effective approach. Such systems should align with an organization’s strategic goals and seamlessly integrate with other HR functions. This course is designed to help HR professionals understand the fundamentals of talent management, explore relevant tools, and design a customized system tailored to their organization's needs.
audience: This course is ideal for supervisors, managers, and HR professionals, especially those specializing in talent management with at least three years of corporate experience. It is particularly beneficial for HR team leaders, HR managers, HR business partners, and line managers.
methodology: The course emphasizes practical application through workshops. Participants will engage in case studies, explore tools, design competency and assessment frameworks, and develop a talent management strategy for implementation in their organizations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Design a talent management system aligned with company strategy
Develop competency frameworks for talent acquisition, review, and development
Utilize effective tools and techniques to assess talent potential
Implement impactful development methods to train, develop, and coach talent
Evaluate organizational readiness and establish a strategic roadmap for integrating a talent management system
